The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Ganne]] had a '''compound''' in the [[Gungan Swamp]] northwest of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Rellias]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the compound was [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|attacked]] by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] led by [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. Their forces destroyed the compound before moving on to attack Rellias.<ref name="GB" />
